actualBetaCheck.proof: actual Tern + our Luau plugin + local synthetic TSP program
limitations: Headless fixture window; no restored user desktop

ompSourceReview.finding: The sendable editor must be below the normal omp.editor wrapper in the omp.session dock.

notes: The production Luau plugin was copied unchanged into the isolated headless fixture.
The synthetic child speaks TSP over Tern's real PTY; no provider credentials were supplied.
Different-user config validation was tested with a mocked current UID because this environment rejects chown.
Tern exposes no canonical OMP conversation or entry IDs; bounded view reconciliation remains conservative.
